calibration: C1 at scoring time through actual design. Nominal intervals never gate eligibility. C2 actual sweep time with donor endpoint range widened ten percent on each side. C3 supplied per span A26 weights.

_applicability.seconds_scope: C2 actual sweep times within donor endpoint range widened by ten percent
_applicability.note: C1 calibration uses only design quantities. Outside C2 seconds support the dimensionless correlation subfamily remains calibrated.

D1.seconds_scope: C2 actual sweep times within donor endpoint range widened by ten percent
D1.assumptions: Frozen v4 empirical day and emission extension with C1 actual design and C2 actual sweep times.
D1.description: D1 two 300 position monitor jobs using the day 3 design metadata as a nominal example. Any actual span count is calibrated afresh. The shuffled job is beside the monitor prediction.

_applicability.seconds_scope: C2 actual sweep times within donor endpoint range widened by ten percent
_applicability.note: C1 calibration uses only design quantities. Outside C2 seconds support the dimensionless correlation subfamily remains calibrated.

D2.seconds_scope: C2 actual sweep times within donor endpoint range widened by ten percent
D2.assumptions: Frozen v4 empirical day and emission extension with C1 actual design and C2 actual sweep times.
D2.description: D2 one 600 position job, six contiguous 100 position spans, readout at the first and last two positions, sweep time the mean of donor sweep times

counts_against.families: Scenario specific conservative Monte Carlo cutoff with estimated smallest cutoff beside; calibrations are joint across shared day and job parameters
counts_against.sharing: Any monitor span INDEPENDENT or UNDECIDED under test 15 sharing ratio
counts_against.dwell: More than one monitor span with the declared dwell p below 0.01
counts_against.boundary: A matching boundary reads CHANGE where its own conditional predicted CHANGE probability is below 0.05
counts_against.undefined_quantity: Not fully testable, retained with reason; no reduced family cutoff substituted

middle_span_pattern: No channel, parameter or bet added. No prediction beyond stationarity within a job. Span position has no effect in the model.

limits.fixed_date_means: The hierarchy contains three fixed observed date means, not an identified future date population.
limits.emissions: Empirical donors on three dates only.
limits.shuffled_sd: No unique observed population length scalar is specified; observed sd remains unavailable with alternatives recorded.
limits.shuffled_weight: Assumed relation to time averaged duty with absolute 0.011 allowance.

prior_record_limits.middle_fifth_mismatch: Retained from test 11 job 2; predictions remain conditional despite this strain
prior_record_limits.undefined_model_length: Unrestricted transitions can make real positive length unavailable; scorer never treats that as a numerical interval miss

limits.chronology: Seconds conditional on chronological returned order and even sweep spacing.

adoption: Nothing adopted; ready for the author to hash before the future run.
